title: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Make Your Phone Hot. Here’s How to Keep It Cool
gist: How-to guide explaining that Android Auto and CarPlay heat phones and drain batteries because the handset drives a large dashboard display and real-time maps on top of normal tasks. Tips: prefer wired connections with charge limits, avoid wireless dash pads, mount near AC vents, remove cases and pre-download maps and media to cut modem load.
